finding.title: Buffer-cooling alpha choice on an exact tie moves the rate by 1-2 ulp only; no check can see it (coordinator.py:5679)
finding.claim: With `observed < self._buffer_cooling_rate` -> `<=`, an observation equal to the current rate blends with ALPHA_DOWN instead of ALPHA_UP, moving the written rate by one or two ulp (1.6564106040767905 -> ...907) on 3 of 6 tie rates tried, and the full gate stays green beyond its null.
finding.metric_definition: the _buffer_cooling_rate written after one interval whose implied rate equals the current rate bit-for-bit

perturbation.expected_direction: rate changes by <= 2 ulp (~4.4e-16 C/h) on a tie; samples unchanged

finding.mechanism: (1-a)*r + a*r == r mathematically, so only float rounding differs: behaviour change negligible
finding.phenomenon_property: every guard/branch of this function changes an observable output on some reachable input, and the suite asserts that output on that input
